## What's new

- **Play any surah with one tap.** Surahs that are not downloaded yet download first, then start playing on their own. This works from the list, the next/previous buttons and the notification.
- **Continue where you stopped.** Every surah remembers its position. A "Start over" button appears when a surah resumes.
- **Download a whole juz.** A new button at the top of the list downloads every surah in a juz, after showing its size and checking free space.
- **Better sleep timer.**
  - New "End of surah" option
  - The sound fades out over the last 30 seconds
  - Remaining time shows in the notification
- **Smarter search.** "الاسراء" finds "الإسراء", "سورة البقره" finds "البقرة", diacritics are ignored and Arabic digits work. Android Auto voice search uses the same matching.
- **Simpler auto-play button.** Each tap moves to the next mode: off → next surah → previous surah, in the app and in the notification.

## Fixes

- A surah whose download was cancelled could not be downloaded again.
- The juz folders in Android Auto were missing most surahs.
- The sleep timer stopped working after the app was swiped away.
- Saving a surah to the device or clearing downloads could freeze the app.
- A playback error could delete a downloaded surah that was fine.
- The notification could stay on "Downloading…" after a download was cancelled or failed.
- Next is now hidden on An-Nas and previous on Al-Fatiha.
- The notification artwork now follows dark mode and wallpaper color changes.
- Screen readers now read download and save buttons in Arabic.

## Under the hood

- Smoother playback screen and less battery use while the app is in the background.
- Code reorganized into smaller files, with unit tests for the surah data and search.
